children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Is my brand direction locked in forever?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: No. Your brand direction is a living artifact. While Phase 02 establishes a solid baseline required for moving into intelligence gathering, you will likely refine your brand tone and visual narrative as you gather real market feedback in Phase 03.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: What is the exact difference between positioning and branding?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: Positioning is where you sit in the market relative to competitors (the space you occupy in the customer's mind). Branding is how you look, feel, and sound while occupying that space. Positioning is the strategic coordinate; branding is the flag you plant there.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Do I need to file trademarks before Phase O3?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: It is generally not necessary to file formal trademarks at this specific juncture. Phase 03 focuses on validating the business logic. We recommend consulting legal counsel for trademark strategy once the core market intelligence confirms the viability of the name and brand concept.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: How do I validate my differentiation in the real world?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: Validation occurs in Phase 03 through Market Intelligence. You will test your Phase 02 assumptions against actual competitor data, search trends, and direct customer interviews to see if your proposed differentiation truly resonates.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Is this the same as a traditional business plan?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: No. Phase 02 establishes the foundational narrative and identity. The "AI Business Plan" in Phase 03 is an agile, dynamic document designed to test operational mechanics, replacing static, traditional multi-page plans with functional business logic.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Can I go back and edit Phase O2 items later?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: Yes. The platform is designed for iterative learning. If Phase 03 reveals that your initial customer targeting was too broad, you can seamlessly return to Phase 02 and tighten the Customer and Problem modules.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: What is the first step in Phase O3?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: The immediate next step is initiating the AI Business Plan module. It will use the 9 components you just completed in Phase 02 as the prompt context to generate a draft structural business model for your review.
